_comment: P3 OWNER REVIEW -- shell_hall_transit, the first LARGE authored
room. GENERATED by tools/shots/gen_p3_owner_review.py; edit that.
The shell exports review: 'pending' and nothing in this package
changes that. It is for the owner's form review: is this the big
open area the P3 direction asked for.
Views 1-8 are the room as it ships. Overlays A-F add explanatory
geometry DERIVED from the shipped manifest -- no view has been
composed to flatter the room, and the overlay figures cannot
disagree with the data because they are built from it.

shots.name: H1_entry
shots.caption: 1  ENTRY - THE FIRST READ, FROM INSIDE THE DOOR
shots.note: THE VESTIBULE IS 5.5 M. THE HALL IS 38. THE EXIT IS ALREADY VISIBLE

shots.name: H2_hero
shots.caption: 2  PRIMARY - THE WHOLE VOLUME, DOWN THE LONG AXIS
shots.note: FOUR OCCUPIED LAYERS AND A LANDMARK STANDING IN THE MIDDLE

shots.name: H3_over
shots.caption: 3  OVER - THE ARRANGEMENT, FROM JUST UNDER THE ROOF
shots.note: GALLERY WEST, GANTRY EAST, LANDING NORTH, CORE IN THE MIDDLE

shots.name: H4_low
shots.caption: 4  LOW - STANDING ON THE BASIN, BESIDE THE ARMATURE
shots.note: ONE CONTINUOUS FLOOR AT Y=0. A MISS COSTS HEIGHT, NEVER THE LEVEL

shots.name: H5_mid
shots.caption: 5  MID - ON THE WEST GALLERY AT Y=11, THE FIRST CLIMB
shots.note: THE CORE OCCLUDES THE EAST SIDE FROM HERE. THE ROOM KEEPS GIVING

shots.name: H6_high
shots.caption: 6  HIGH - ON THE EAST GANTRY AT Y=21, FACING THE LAST RAMP
shots.note: THE LANDING REGION OF THE LAUNCH PAIR IS THIS DECK

shots.name: H7_reverse
shots.caption: 7  REVERSE - FROM THE EXIT PLATFORM AT Y=28, LOOKING BACK
shots.note: 60 M BACK TO THE DOOR, AND EVERY LAYER VISIBLE FROM HERE

shots.name: H8_vertical
shots.caption: 8  VERTICAL - UP THE ARMATURE SHAFT FROM THE BASIN
shots.note: 12 M OF OPEN AIR THROUGH THREE COLLARS, FLOOR TO ROOF

shots.name: O1_regions
shots.caption: A  SPATIAL REGIONS - EVERY DECLARED STAND SURFACE
shots.note: GREEN: WALKABLE. VIOLET: ENEMY_HIGH SOCKETS. FROM THE MANIFEST

shots.name: O2_route
shots.caption: B  THE MANDATORY ROUTE - ON FOOT, NO MOVEMENT PACKAGE
shots.note: THICK: THE NINE DECLARED LINKS. THIN: THE CROSSINGS BETWEEN THEM

shots.name: O3_rail
shots.caption: C  OFFER: RAIL_ROUTE - ELEVEN POINTS, TWICE AROUND THE CORE
shots.note: AN OFFER, NOT A RAIL. NOTHING EXISTS UNTIL A PACKAGE BUILDS IT

shots.name: O4_launch
shots.caption: D  OFFER: LAUNCH PAIR - BASIN TO GANTRY, 24.5 M APART
shots.note: NO ARC IS DRAWN. LAUNCHSOLVER OWNS THE TRAJECTORY, NOT ART

shots.name: O5_overhead
shots.caption: E  OVERHEAD STRUCTURE - THE GRAPPLE QUESTION, NOT AN OFFER
shots.note: GRAPPLE_ANCHOR IS NOT IN OFFER_KINDS. THIS IS WHAT IT WOULD USE

shots.name: O6_shaft
shots.caption: F  VERTICAL MOVEMENT REGION - THE SHAFT, FLOOR TO CORE TOP
shots.note: CONTINUOUS AND UNOBSTRUCTED. WIND, LIFT OR PLATFORMS ALL WANT THIS
